- Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` and `references/area-lease.md` (⛔ not copied here).

## Current PM — 🟢 os-justin

- **Seated:** `os-justin` · `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ` · 2026-11-24T01:32Z, on the maintainer's summons in the session: 「开一个 objectstack 座位 ，处理 p1 任务」. The previous holder's clock-out brief (body revision of 2026-11-22, `os-project-manager` · `session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv`) was the newest event on this post; no comment followed it.
- **Intake (narrowed 2026-11-24T16:04Z):** the maintainer in this seat's session, verbatim: 「你后续只处理  36890  37000 专题，和 ux 的 p1 p2 卡」, then on in-hand work 「受伤的继续处理完」 (read as 手上的 — finish what is in hand). From now this seat takes only: epic #36890 (zone **a4-S**), epic #37000 (zone **a4-K**), and `area:ux` cards at `priority:p1` and `priority:p2` (cards seat repo:objectstack#3 holds stay with it). **Finished to MERGED, then dropped:** #36839 / PR #36850, #36982 / PR #37012, #36967 / PR #37014, #35399 / PR #36869, #36650 / PR #36823, #36868 / PR #36957, #36942 / PR #36965. **Also kept**, by the maintainer's next message, verbatim: 「这些你都继续处理 #36957 … #37004 … #36942 合并后解锁的 #36943（首页「我的任务」）」 (recorded 2026-11-24T16:05Z): ADR-0159's implementation cards ② to ⑤ after PR #36957 merges, #37004 (RAGFlow retirement), and #36943 once #36942 closes. **Plus** `area:ai` cards at priority:p1 and p2, run by zone **a4-A** — the maintainer in this seat's session, verbatim: 「再开一个区，处理 area:ai 的 p1 p2 卡」 (recorded 2026-11-24T16:40Z). **Plus** every `area:ux` epic at priority:p1 or p2 except Studio #36890 (a4-S's) — #36359, #35547, #36255, #36107, #36062, #35880, #35683, #35590, #34571 and any new one — with their p1/p2 child cards, run by zone **a4-C** — the maintainer in this seat's session, verbatim: 「再开一个区，接手这个专题和相关的子专题」 (on #34571), then 「你这个新区应该接手 ux 所有的专题卡 p1 p2」 (recorded 2026-11-24T16:46Z); child cards of those epics leave zone a4-U's `area:ux` scope. **Not taken:** every other card outside these scopes. Earlier intake lines (all p0/p1 except `area:cloud`/`area:ux`, the `area:fleet` removal, new `area:ux` cards) are superseded by this one; their quotes stay in this post's edit history. Security advisories stay with the security lane.
- **Mailbox:** PR #36810. **Patrol:** none — the self-bound patrol routine could not be created in this session (permission refused); wakes come from PR subscriptions (mailbox and in-flight PRs).
- Seat-session tier: the session's default tier, effort as launched (not re-measured at seating).
